steps.title: Your creator dashboard
steps.description: This is your private workspace. From here, you can build, publish, and manage the portfolio recruiters will see.

steps.title: Start with your portfolio
steps.description: Create the main page that introduces your work. It stays private until you choose to publish it.

steps.title: Give it a clear story
steps.description: Use a focused title and short bio so recruiters quickly understand who you are and the kind of work you do.

steps.title: Create, add work, then publish
steps.description: After creating the portfolio, you can add images or videos, choose what is public, and share one recruiter-friendly link.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.description: Your dashboard also contains account controls. Never upload confidential, private, or client-restricted material.
